title: O God! We Praise Thee, and Confess
description: O God! We Praise Thee, and Confess in Tonic Solfa to ST ANNE, doh is C: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 5 verses and a piano.
about: John Patrick wrote these words. They were printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion, compiled by Samuel Longfellow and Samuel Johnson (Boston, 1848), as hymn 50, “Te Deum”.
The book printed the words without tunes, marked Common Metre (8.6.8.6), to be sung to any tune of that metre. This page sets them to ST ANNE; any other Common Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: O God! we praise Thee, and con-fess That Thou the on-ly Lord And ev-er-last-ing Fa-ther art, By all the earth a-dored.

lines: O God! we praise Thee, and confess
To Thee all angels cry aloud;
To Thee the powers on high,
The world is with the glory filled
With all the martyrs' noble host,
The holy church throughout the world,
That Thou the Eternal Father art,

source: A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848)
licence: Public domain: John Patrick died in 1695.
credits: Words by John Patrick (1632–1695), public domain, as printed in A Book of Hymns for Public and Private Devotion (1848); set to ST ANNE by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
